intro: You are at the Gevher Nesibe Hospital, a madrasa and hospital in Kayseri province, built in 1206. It is the first known building to set a hospital and a medical school side by side. Picture it: patients being treated, while across the same courtyard students took their lessons.
history: In 1206 Kayhusraw I, acting on the will of his sister Gevher Nesibe, had a hospital and a medical school built side by side at Kayseri. Placing them next to each other brought the care of patients and the teaching of students into the same courtyard — the first known arrangement of its kind.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the hospital courtyard, the medical school, the tomb of Gevher Nesibe and the portals.
facts: Did you know? The building set aside rooms for the treatment of mental illness, among the earliest cases of psychiatric care inside a hospital. And it is the first known building to set a hospital and a medical school next to each other: patients were treated while students studied across the same courtyard.
outro: This brings our tour of the Gevher Nesibe Hospital to an end. Before you go, please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. A place of healing for centuries; let it welcome those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
